errors.trigger: Run object missing or handoff context incomplete
errors.diagnosis: Some fields expected in the handoff document are missing or empty
errors.rescue_action: Halt if run object is missing; otherwise write available context and clearly note gaps
errors.user_message: Handoff context is incomplete. Missing: {gaps}. Proceeding only with available context.

errors.diagnosis: The run object exists but fails JSON parse or schema validation
errors.rescue_action: Show validator output and suggest restore before handoff
errors.user_message: Run object is corrupted or invalid. Restore it before writing handoff.

errors.trigger: Handoff write/rename fails or is interrupted
errors.rescue_action: Keep prior handoff where possible, clean temp files, and retry
errors.user_message: Could not write handoff safely. Existing handoff was preserved where possible.
